questions.name: 2026 World Cup champion
questions.description: The question resolves by assigning Yes to the listed outcome whose national team is officially declared the 2026 HYPURR testnet World Cup champion. The result includes the full final, including extra time and penalties, if played. If HYPURR officially declares a champion without a completed final, that official champion determines resolution. If the final is postponed or delayed, the rescheduled final is used, provided HYPURR declares a champion by October 13, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET. HYPURR is the primary resolution source; a consensus of credible reporting may be used if HYPURR information is unavailable or unclear. If no listed outcome is officially declared champion by that deadline, no outcome resolves to Yes under this spec. metadata=category:sports|subCategory:football
